noSearchResults: No matching plugins. Try another keyword.
importPackageHint: Choose one .jxp package, then review permissions and enable the plugin.
importSucceeded: Plugin package installed. Review permissions and enable it to start.
importUntrusted: The publisher could not be verified, or this app does not trust its native service. Use a supported app and official package.
importInvalid: This package is incomplete, corrupt or unsupported. Choose a complete .jxp plugin package.
importBlocked: This version cannot be installed. Disable the installed plugin and choose a newer version. Remove any development source for this plugin first.
importReadFailed: The selected package could not be read. Check that the file exists and is accessible.
importFailed: Package installation failed. The previous version was retained. Check the package and try again.
settingsEnableRequired: This plugin can't load its settings page right now. Check its status in the plugin manager.
projectGrantRequired: This plugin has not been authorized for the current project. Review permissions and select this project to open the view.
projectScopeEmpty: No projects selected. Project views will be unavailable; application settings remain available.
handoffHint: Confirm to create a terminal and prefill the task. Review it in the terminal, then send it manually.
handoffScopeChanged: The project or plugin changed. Return to the original project and enable the plugin to continue.
handoffFileFailed: The source file could not be opened. Retry from the file list.
handoffLaunchFailed: The terminal could not be created or prefilled. Your draft is preserved; check existing terminals before retrying.
workspaceHandoffHint: Allows opening project files in the host editor and proposing terminal task drafts for your review. Creating a terminal requires confirmation.
conflictReviewHint: Compare the disk version with your draft below. Edit your draft to merge the changes, then save the reviewed result. The disk version will be checked again.
nativePermissionHint: This plugin includes an official native service with your user account's access to files, network and system resources. A separate process isolates crashes; it is not a permission sandbox. Enable only if you trust this official release.
rollbackHint: Restore the previous plugin code and keep current user data. Enable the plugin again after restoring.
catalogHint: Download official plugins as needed. After installation, review permissions and enable them under Installed.
catalogEmpty: The official catalog has no available plugins yet.
catalogNotConfigured: This build has no official signing key configured. Downloads are unavailable; installed plugins can still be managed.
catalogStale: The catalog has expired or is older than the saved version. Refresh it and try again.
downloadInvalid: Signature or file verification failed. The installed version was preserved.
downloadFailed: Download or installation failed. Check your connection and retry. The previous version was preserved.
downloadNotFound: The official catalog or package has not been published or has been removed. The publisher must restore the download source. Installed plugins were not changed.
incompatible: This plugin version does not support the current application or platform.
stopBeforeUpdate: Save your work and disable the plugin under Installed before updating.
installedHint: Manage permissions, activation and configuration under Installed.
configurationDraftHint: Unsaved changes are kept for this app session when you switch scope or close settings.
configurationDiscardHint: Reloading will discard unsaved changes in this scope. Continue?
configurationResetHint: Resetting will remove saved overrides and discard unsaved changes in this scope. Continue?
configurationReview: This plugin proposed these changes. Review the fields and save to apply them. Nothing has been saved yet.
configurationMigrationHint: Review renamed settings in this scope. Applying moves compatible old values to empty new fields. Existing or incompatible values are preserved. Save or reload pending edits first.

configurationMigrationStatus.incompatible: Value or scope incompatible; kept unchanged

configurationHint: Configure plugin parameters here. Credentials are not supported in ordinary settings. Configuration does not grant extra permissions.
configurationIssues: Some saved fields are incompatible and have been ignored. Stored data is retained:
configurationInvalid: A value does not match the declared type or bounds.
configurationConflict: Configuration changed elsewhere. Your edits are kept. Reload the configuration before trying again.
documentConflict: The file changed on disk. Your draft is kept; saving was blocked. Review the differences below. If the file is unavailable, copy your draft before reopening it.
defaultViewer: Use by default for this file type
viewerDirty: Save or discard changes before switching viewers.
viewerFallback: Plugin viewer unavailable. Using the built-in viewer.
hostBoundary: Local plugins use declared permissions. Background tasks and external requests are supervised by the host.
title: Plugins
subtitle: Install features as needed and manage permissions and configuration
developmentHint: Run local plugins after reviewing their permissions. Turning this off disables all local plugins.
empty: No plugins installed. Discover plugins to add features as needed.
grantHint: Enabled plugins are available in all current and future workspaces. Application views cannot read project files.
uninstallHint: Uninstall removes plugin resources and entries. Private data is retained; linked source files are retained.
deleteHint: Permanently delete this plugin's private data? Active plugin pages will be closed.
themeHint: After authorization, choose these palettes in Appearance. Settings and approvals retain built-in colors; the palette applies when they close. Unavailable plugins fall back to the built-in theme. Theme selection is application-wide; plugin configuration keeps its existing scopes. No CSS or scripts are loaded.
windowHint: Windows use the same isolated plugin permissions. Closing discards page-local edits; saved private data and background tasks follow their existing rules. Reopening restores window position and size, not unsaved content. Project windows close on project or worktree changes. Plugin content is hidden while host dialogs or approvals are open.
contextHint: The built-in Agent can read these saved project files on demand after authorization. Reads are limited to 32 KiB and return untrusted data; unsaved editor drafts are excluded. Disabling stops future reads but cannot erase text already read into a conversation.
workflowHint: Review every service and its input mapping. Agent approval covers the whole sequence, including external effects. A failed or stopped step prevents later steps; completed effects are not undone. No automatic retries.
skillHint: Skills supply third-party guidance to the built-in Agent. Reading a skill does not run its services or grant extra access. Service calls still follow host approval. Review this text before enabling; disabling the plugin stops future reads, but cannot erase content already read into a conversation.
modelHint: Model tasks send their input to your default Janus model and may incur charges. Up to 2 requests per minute per plugin, with at most 1,024 output tokens per request. Disabling the plugin stops new requests.
backgroundHint: Tasks continue after closing their page. Switching projects stops project tasks. Stop tasks here; retry by running again. History is kept for this app session.
